description: Native search-override child-continuation target-only audit. Test whether the model can fit child positions from cases where root eval wanted the target move but search overrode it.

metadata.final_recovery_result: The final recovery model retained target fit with exact .pt/.nn parity: 1064/1400 top1 and 1346/1400 top3, with final broad drift around 105cp. Corrected native-32 10k search rejected it against the parent: top1 425/1409, compare 181 candidate-better vs 717 parent-better, capped -65161.
metadata.diagnosis: On the unified corpus the exported model itself reached 682/1409 top1, but Enyo search followed the model root move on only 442/1409. In the model_top1_search_override subset, parent was better 345 times vs 9 candidate-better, so root-only training is not enough.
metadata.targets: runs/native-searchaware-override-child-targets-20260525/override_child_targets.jsonl: 160 child positions from the worst model-top1/search-override cases, scored at 50k nodes per legal move and built with max_moves=16.
metadata.hypothesis: If the model can fit these child-continuation targets, a later recovered run may make the root-preferred move stable under search instead of only under static child evaluation.
metadata.gate: Target-only diagnostic only. Exported .pt/.nn model gate must reach at least 120/160 top1 on override_child_targets before any recovery or engine gate is considered.
metadata.decision: If target-only cannot fit the child-continuation corpus, close this path. If it fits, run a separate recovered child-continuation model with broad parent distillation and only then a corrected native-32 10k gate.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must reach at least 120/160 top1 on the override-child corpus with exact .pt/.nn parity.
validation.next_if_model_passes: Configure a separate recovered child-continuation run with broad parent distillation.
validation.hard_stop: No corrected native-32 engine gate or SPRT from the target-only diagnostic.
